approvedTestCases.title: Validate account creation and session entry
preconditions: QA user has valid demo test data.
No production money movement is used during execution.
steps: Navigate to the target web application.
Confirm the primary journey is visible and interactive.
Enter valid customer profile details.
Submit account creation.
Verify the KYC onboarding step becomes available.
approvedTestCases.expectedResult: The approved journey completes without blocking errors.
assertions: Expected success or status text is visible.
approvedTestCases.rationale: A release demo fails immediately if a new customer cannot create an account and enter the product.

approvedTestCases.title: Validate KYC onboarding state progression
preconditions: QA user has valid demo test data.
No production money movement is used during execution.
steps: Navigate to the target web application.
Confirm the primary journey is visible and interactive.
Complete the account creation step if required.
Enter valid KYC identity data.
Submit KYC details.
Verify the KYC status moves forward with clear messaging.
approvedTestCases.expectedResult: KYC details are accepted and the user sees a clear review or approval state.
assertions: Identity form is not left in an error state.
approvedTestCases.rationale: KYC is a fintech identity gate and a common release blocker for onboarding flows.

approvedTestCases.title: Validate payment success and wallet balance update
preconditions: QA user has valid demo test data.
No production money movement is used during execution.
steps: Navigate to the target web application.
Confirm the primary journey is visible and interactive.
Complete account and KYC prerequisites if required.
Enter payment amount and payee.
Run fraud/risk check.
Submit payment.
Verify wallet balance and transaction status update.
approvedTestCases.expectedResult: Payment completes once and wallet balance reflects the expected amount.
approvedTestCases.rationale: Money movement and balance accuracy have the highest customer and compliance impact.

approvedTestCases.title: Validate failed or duplicate payment handling
preconditions: QA user has valid demo test data.
No production money movement is used during execution.
steps: Navigate to the target web application.
Confirm the primary journey is visible and interactive.
Complete account and KYC prerequisites if required.
Enter payment amount and payee.
Run fraud/risk check.
Submit payment.
Verify wallet balance and transaction status update.
approvedTestCases.expectedResult: The approved journey completes without blocking errors.
approvedTestCases.rationale: Duplicate or ambiguous payment states can create financial loss and reconciliation issues.

approvedTestCases.title: Validate refund initiation and status visibility
preconditions: QA user has valid demo test data.
No production money movement is used during execution.
steps: Navigate to the target web application.
Confirm the primary journey is visible and interactive.
Complete a successful payment prerequisite if required.
Trigger refund for the latest eligible transaction.
Verify refund status and wallet timeline update.
approvedTestCases.expectedResult: Refund can be initiated and the status is visible to the user.
approvedTestCases.rationale: Refund errors damage trust and are often tied to legacy regression risk.
